title: Avoid starting a write transaction under `ShowCanCreateAgent`
summary: Payables Agent Setup now calls ShowCanCreateAgent after committing transactions to prevent write transaction conflicts when third-party code modifies records.
key_points: ShowCanCreateAgent is invoked after the Commit statement, not before
Prevents write transaction conflicts with third-party extensions that modify records and then call Confirm
Aligns with platform-side changes addressing the root cause in bug 646707
Affects both the Payables Agent Setup codeunit and table
